details:
Q1. What part of the repository should be improved?
Choices:
A. The AI workflow pipeline behavior under `.github/workflows/` and supporting scripts (RECOMMENDED)
B. Documentation only (`README.md`, guides, comments)
C. A specific script or file you will name in your `/answer`
D. A different area of the repo you will describe in your `/answer`
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure you have observed (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability or correctness of an existing workflow/script
C. Improve developer/operator documentation only
D. Reduce noise/cost/performance overhead without changing user-visible behavior
Q3. What concrete outcome should count as “better” for this issue?
Choices:
A. A failing behavior should be corrected; include the current vs expected behavior in your `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
B. A workflow/script should become more robust; include the exact job, phase, or script name in your `/answer`
C. Docs should be clearer; include the exact section/file and what is confusing in your `/answer`
D. General cleanup/refinement with no specific target
Q4. What evidence or reproduction context do you have?
Choices:
A. I can provide a specific failing workflow run, issue/PR, log snippet, or error message in my `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
B. I can describe the exact user-visible problem but do not have logs
C. I do not have a concrete example; I want a general quality pass
Q5. How tightly should the change be scoped?
Choices:
A. Minimal targeted fix for the specific problem once identified (RECOMMENDED)
B. Small localized improvement in one workflow or script area
C. Broader repo-wide polish/refinement pass
